greeting: It's departure day, Dan — St. Pete this morning, Frankfurt tonight, Dubrovnik in the morning. Everything that needs solid ground and a signal gets closed out before 5:55.

needsAttention.title: Get the Croatia bags confirmed in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued Basic Economy fare shows 0 checked bags on Eurowings Discover, overdue since Aug 25. Pull the booking up on the operating carrier's site with the record locator and buy bags online today — two 55L duffels get refused at tonight's counter.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Sept 19 Cavtat night and transfer
needsAttention.detail: P1, overdue. The charter has no connectivity, so the post-sail night in Cavtat and the noon Komolac to Cavtat transfer both have to be booked before you board the 5:55.

needsAttention.title: Book the St Pete landing gap, Sept 20 to 22
needsAttention.detail: Travel P1. You land TPA Sunday the 20th but the kids aren't picked up until Tuesday the 22nd; the two nights before the Orlando villa need booking today, while you still have a signal.

needsAttention.title: Confirm boarding and return transfer with Nautilus
needsAttention.detail: Travel P2, overdue Sept 5. Nail down the Sat Sept 12 boarding time and location plus the Sept 19 airport transfer now, before bandwidth disappears at sea.

needsAttention.title: Call Halloween: St Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: Travel P2, overdue Sept 5. The Oct 18 to Nov 1 St Pete rental and car both cover Halloween and rebook while you're away, so this decides before the boat, not from it.

needsAttention.title: Drop the larder bin at Mom's on the way
needsAttention.detail: Household. The bin lives at Mom's in Tampa through the gap; House 2 checks out at 10 and she's on the St Pete to TPA line, so set a 15-minute drop before noon rather than a visit.

schedule.title: House 2 checkout
schedule.detail: St. Pete ranch, bags in the car

schedule.title: Rental car back at TPA
schedule.detail: Larder bin to Mom en route

schedule.title: UA9661 TPA to Frankfurt
schedule.detail: Croatia trip begins; DBV tomorrow AM

flagged.title: GitHub token expires in 1 day
flagged.detail: GitHub flagged the briefings-deploy access token as expiring tomorrow; renew it before it lapses.

flagged.title: New Google sign-ins to review
flagged.detail: Google flagged a new sign-in Sept 7 and account data shared with santosregroup.com; confirm both were you.

flagged.title: Flight check-in is open
flagged.detail: United and Kayak have the TPA to FRA boarding pass ready; check in before you leave for the airport.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and receipts, America's Test Kitchen, NYT Cooking, Daily Italian, a few store promos.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Butternut squash & candied bacon on fresh pasta
recipe.why: Early autumn brings the first winter squash to market, sweet enough to carry a smoky-savory pasta.

tasks.title: Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip
Book the refundable backup car, Sept 20 to Oct 5
Finish the Nautilus Masterclass videos (~68% done)

acts.line: Checkout at 10 and the rental back by noon make for a tight, moving morning before the airport.
The stretch between noon and boarding is your last window on solid ground and good signal.
Wheels up for Frankfurt, then Dubrovnik in the morning; the sailing week starts here.
